Container.Name: libre-webui
Container.Overview:
Libre WebUI is a privacy-first, self-hosted AI platform: chat with local models through Ollama or with cloud providers, plus agents, automations and a knowledge base, all from a single container.
Everything lives in your own data volume: chat history, uploads and keys never leave your server unless you point it at a cloud model provider yourself.
On first run, open the WebUI and create the first account. That account automatically becomes the administrator. Further signups are disabled by default (ENABLE_SIGNUP=false) so random users on your network can't register themselves an account; change it in the template if you want an open signup page.
Ollama is optional. Libre WebUI runs fine without it and can talk to cloud model providers configured from inside the app; point OLLAMA_BASE_URL at a reachable Ollama instance if you want local models.
Note: the "Work" sandboxed task-container feature is not available in this packaging because it requires mounting the host Docker socket, which this template deliberately does not do. Everything else (chat, agents, automations, knowledge) works normally.
Website: https://librewebui.org Docs: https://docs.librewebui.org
Container.Requires: Optional: a reachable Ollama instance for local models. Cloud model providers can be configured entirely from inside the app.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: chat llm ollama ai assistant agents automations knowledge

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Libre WebUI web interface, REST API and WebSocket (single port for everything). Change the host side (left) if 8080 is already used; do not change the container side (right).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: All persistent data: SQLite database, uploads and encryption keys. Back this up.

Config.Name: Temp
Config.Description: Scratch space used for temporary/preflight processing. Safe to clear; no need to back up.

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: REQUIRED. A random 64-character hex secret used to sign login sessions. This app does not auto-generate one for store deployments, so you must set it yourself before starting the container, e.g. run `openssl rand -hex 32` on any Mac/Linux/WSL terminal and paste the result here. Changing it later logs everyone out.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Base URL of an Ollama instance to use for local models. The default reaches Ollama running on the Unraid host itself or in a host-network container (an --add-host mapping is included, so it works out of the box). If you run Ollama in its own bridge-network container instead, replace this with that container's name (e.g. http://ollama:11434 if both are on the same custom Docker network) or the server's LAN IP. Entirely optional: leave as-is and just use cloud providers configured from inside the app if you don't run Ollama.

Config.Name: Enable Signup
Config.Description: Allow new users to self-register from the login page. The very first account created is always made administrator regardless of this setting. Leave false unless you want an open signup page on your network.

Config.Name: JWT Expiry
Config.Description: How long a login session stays valid before requiring re-login, e.g. 7d, 24h.

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: Optional. Key used to encrypt stored provider credentials at rest. Leave empty to auto-generate one into the data volume on first boot.

Config.Name: CORS Origin
Config.Description: Allowed CORS origin(s). Defaults to * because store/LAN installs are reached via mDNS names or bare IPs that a strict allowlist can't predict; authentication is JWT bearer tokens, not ambient cookies, so this does not weaken login security. Tighten it only if you front this with a reverse proxy on a fixed hostname.

Config.Name: Docker Environment Flag
Config.Description: Tells the app it is running in a container. Do not change.

Config.Name: Internal Port
Config.Description: Internal port the process listens on inside the container. Must stay 3001 and match the WebUI Port container-side value above. Do not change.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal path matching the Data volume mapping above. Do not change.

Config.Name: Preflight Temp Directory
Config.Description: Internal scratch path under the Temp volume mapping above. Do not change.
